headline: German police have seized a robot that allegedly groped a teenage girl in Cologne and are investigating its 16-year-old owner and a 19-year-old companion.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: a widely covered case of a robot allegedly harming a person, with the new police probe today; the incident itself is older.
importance_line: The alleged victim is a 16-year-old girl, and the accused are a 16-year-old and a 19-year-old, but police are still working out whether anyone was controlling the robot, so who is responsible is still open.
summary: BBC News reports that North Rhine-Westphalia police have opened an investigation into the 16-year-old owner of a red and gold robot, about 120 cm (3.9 ft) tall, and his 19-year-old companion, who are accused of controlling it and are believed to have streamed live when it allegedly grabbed a 16-year-old girl's buttocks in Cologne close to midnight on Saturday 10 Oct 2026. The case was first reported on 12 Oct 2026, and in a follow-up Facebook post police warned that some online comments about it could amount to a criminal offence.
notes: Read in full from the pool fulltext (short BBC article). First reported 12 Oct 2026 (Cologne police statement); new today is the investigation of the two young men.
